evidence: The surface chemistry during the ALD of NiS was investigated using in situ XPS, LEIS, QCM, and QMS. The in situ XPS experiments were carried out on a home-modified Escalab 250Xi XPS system. In situ QCM measurements were performed in a home-built tubular ALD reactor. The QMS system contained a turbo-pumping high-vacuum chamber connected to the deposition chamber via an orifice. The in situ XPS investigation suggested that the surface chemistry deviated from the conventional ligand-exchange scheme. The QCM results corroborated the proposed surface chemistry mechanism.
